achievements.name: Hyrule Field
achievements.detail: Clear the first story battle by driving the monsters off Hyrule Field.

achievements.name: Four Champions
achievements.detail: Have Mipha, Daruk, Revali, and Urbosa all available to take into battle.

achievements.name: Divine Beast
achievements.detail: Finish a story battle in which one of the four Divine Beasts takes the field.

achievements.name: Master Sword
achievements.detail: Obtain the Master Sword for Link by clearing the Korok Forest story battle.

achievements.name: Guardian Broken
achievements.detail: Destroy a Guardian during a battle.

achievements.name: Lynel Down
achievements.detail: Defeat a Lynel during a battle.

achievements.name: Korok Found
achievements.detail: Find a Korok hidden on a battlefield.

achievements.name: Weapon Fused
achievements.detail: Strengthen a weapon by fusing other weapons into it at the blacksmith.

achievements.name: Zelda Deployed
achievements.detail: Win a battle while controlling Zelda.

achievements.name: Timed Challenge
achievements.detail: Clear a Challenge before its timer runs out.

achievements.name: Hinox Down
achievements.detail: Defeat a Hinox during a battle.

achievements.name: Calamity Ganon
achievements.detail: Win the final story battle against Calamity Ganon.
